notes: A 7 now waits for the dice. Number tokens are white with black numbers and no longer flicker; every harbour has a sign with its trade. Emotes and private notes to one player in online games. Offers you cannot pay no longer pop up, a loading screen shows while the board loads, a city sends its settlement back to your stack, and the player cards and hand are bigger on large screens. Fixes for dice over the winner screen and pieces stuck mid-drop. Everyone in a game needs v0.11.0.
